name: Auschwitz Birkenau German Nazi Concentration and Extermination Camp (1940-1945)
description: Near the town of Oświęcim in southern Poland, Auschwitz-Birkenau was the largest of the Nazi camps, begun in 1940 and in use until 1945. Visitors can walk among the surviving barbed-wire fences, rail platforms, wooden barracks, gallows and the ruins of the gas chambers. An estimated 1.1 million people were murdered here, most of them Jews, and it remains a stark memorial to the Holocaust.
